title: Food Scale, 11lb Kitchen Scale with 6 Units Tare Function & LCD Display, 0.05oz/1g Stainless Steel Digital Food Scale Grams and Ounces for Baking, Cooking, Dieting and Meal Prep (Batteries Included)
description:
About this item
[MULTI-FUNCTION SWITCHING MODE]--Food scale can bear a maximum weight of 11LB, and can also provide you with a weight scale accurate to 1 g/0.05 oz. The measurement results are highly accurate. Food scale grams and ounces also has six unit conversion functions: g/kg/lb/oz/ml/milk ml to meet your different needs. When you are making food, there is no need for complicated operations, just one button to easily switch to any unit you want, providing all-round convenience for kitchen work.
[STAY FULL OF ENERGY]--The digital food scale has automatic overload and low battery warning modes, allowing you to receive battery reminders in advance and providing stable support for ensuring kitchen work. Moreover, baking scale is energy-saving and will automatically shut down when not used for two minutes, thereby maintaining its reliable operation for a long time. It is a practical and stable kitchen assistant.
[SATISFY GOURMET LIFE]--Kitchen scale is very simple to use. First, tear off the blue protective film on the surface, install the included 2 AAA batteries and select the ON button on the flat surface to turn on the power; secondly, click the UNIT button to select your unit; then, press the Z/T one-button tare function , reset the weight to zero; finally, put the items into the container, allowing you to easily get the net weight. The simple operation brings you a pleasant baking experience.
[LIGHT UP DIM VISION]--The digital kitchen scale with LCD display can be used by both the elderly and children. The large screen reads the values accurately, displays the numbers clearly, and does not hurt the eyes. It can provide you with night vision mode in dark environments, providing you with Visual escort. For those who love cooking and baking, this is a food weight scale you can’t put down.
[SIMPLE BUT NOT SIMPLE]--The exquisite and compact kitchen food scale is made of high-quality stainless steel. Compared with food scales on the market, it is more waterproof and wear-resistant, and can easily wipe off any stains on the surface to keep it clean and maintained. In order to prevent edge collisions, we adopt a rounded corner design and four anti-slip bases, which increase safety and stability and bring you a more convenient lifestyle.
